name: LiveVariant
summary: Adaptive A/B testing where the whole test lives in a URL: traffic shifts toward the winner while the test runs, and no account is needed to create one.

agentAccess.notes: A test is created by minting a URL; reading its results needs the per-test stats secret returned at creation.

jobs.summary: Builds and serves multi-variant tests from URLs and picks winners by Thompson sampling while the test runs.
On-page website tests through a tag or an SDK, with the winner promoted automatically.
Per-recipient image and click links so an email campaign tests its creative on the way out.

disclosure.statement: Built and maintained by a person; its public growth work is done by the autonomous agent @Prior, listed separately.
